validation.nameRequired: Enter a name (it stays on this machine).
validation.pathNotAbsolute: Use an absolute path, e.g. C:\Code\my-app or /home/me/my-app.

modes.Ask: Agents ask before every change, command or network call. Maximum control — recommended to start.
modes.SemiAuto: Routine work inside the project sandbox runs on its own; anything risky (deletes, installs, pushes) asks first.
modes.FullAuto: Everything your policies allow runs without asking. Dangerous actions (force-push, DROP, prod deploys) still always ask.

errors.saveStorage: Could not save the storage mode.
errors.saveMode: Could not save the permission mode.

wizard.laterNote: Nothing to set up yet — this step unlocks automatically when the feature ships.

profile.lead: Orkestr runs locally. Your profile never leaves this machine — no sign-up, no account.

local.title: Local only
local.body: Projects, history, memory and secrets stay on this computer. You can add sync later.

selfHosted.title: Self-hosted
selfHosted.body: Sync through your own Orkestr server.

cloud.title: Orkestr Cloud
cloud.body: End-to-end encrypted sync across your devices.

providers.hint: Use your own API keys or the official CLIs you are already signed in to (Claude Code, Codex). Keys are stored in the OS secret vault, never in plain text. You can skip this and connect providers later in Settings.

manager.hint: The Manager plans work, splits it into tasks and delegates to agents. A strong reasoning model works best.

permissions.label: Permission mode
permissions.hint: You can change this per project at any time. The emergency stop always works.
permissions.savedAsDefault: Saved as your default; new projects start in this mode.

project.lead: Point Orkestr at an existing folder (a Git repository works best) or create an empty project.
project.folderHint: Absolute path of an existing folder. Leave empty to start without files.

git.lead: Agents work on Git branches and worktrees so every change can be reviewed and rolled back.

terminal.lead: Agents run commands in real terminals. Here is what Orkestr found on this machine.

voice.title: Voice control
voice.body: Wake word, push-to-talk and spoken notifications for the Manager — processed locally where possible.

remote.title: Remote access
remote.body: Reach this machine's agents securely through the Orkestr gateway — the core never opens ports.

sync.title: Cloud sync
sync.body: Encrypted sync of projects, memory and settings between your devices.

mobile.title: Mobile pairing
mobile.body: Approve actions, watch progress and stop agents from your phone.
